messages:
Alex R.: FYI — rolling kernel/driver maintenance for runtime in eu-west-1 and eu-central-1 tonight 23:00-01:00 UTC. Goal: security backports + driver bump. Expect 1hr per region; we'll stagger. Affects hosted runtime and Dedicated burst pools. Need statuspage copy + customer emails. Who can take drafts?

OpsBot: deploy-bot scheduled: maintenance/1948001234 created by @alexr. Window: 2026-03-20T23:00:00Z -> 2026-03-21T01:00:00Z. Affected components: runtime-gpu-eu-west-1, runtime-gpu-eu-central-1.

Maya S.: I can draft both. Do we want a pinning note for Dedicated customers and a quick rollback playbook link? :thinking_face:

Jon P.: Yes — include a clear "how to pin" snippet and recommend temporary fallback routing for latency-sensitive apps. Also add contact for SLA exceptions / emergency account escalation.

Samira K.: Draft below — short statuspage copy + email subject/body. PTAL, I'll iterate.

Samira K.: ```statuspage
Component: Runtime (EU regions)
Status: Scheduled Maintenance
Summary: We will perform scheduled kernel and driver updates on runtime nodes in eu-west-1 and eu-central-1.
Impact: During the window you may observe transient elevated latency and reduced throughput for some Dedicated pools while nodes are restarted. Hosted API may experience short spikes in latency. No request data will be lost.
Start: 2026-03-20 23:00 UTC
End (expected): 2026-03-21 01:00 UTC
Updates: We'll publish progress updates every 15 minutes here and post a final update at completion.
Contact: support@redwoodai.com / status.redwood.ai
```

Samira K.: ```email
Subject: Planned maintenance: runtime kernel updates (eu regions) — 20 Mar 23:00 UTC
Body:
Hi {{customer_name}},

We will be performing scheduled maintenance to update runtime kernels and drivers in our EU regions on 20 Mar from 23:00 to 01:00 UTC. During this time you may see brief periods of elevated latency or reduced throughput for workloads in eu-west-1 and eu-central-1. No data loss is expected.

If you run Dedicated capacity and want to avoid any automatic roll during the window, you can pin your pool to the current runtime version (instructions below). If you need assistance or an SLA exception, reply to this email or contact your account rep.

Thanks,
Redwood Support
```

Alex R.: Good. Add a quick pin example for Dedicated customers, e.g.:

Alex R.: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/dedicated/pools/{pool_id}/pin \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"runtime_version":"2026-03-15-kernel-1.2.3"}'
```

Maya S.: I'll append a note recommending customers enable fallback routing to a compatible model variant for latency-critical endpoints during the window. Also adding: @support please prep the canned responses for inbound tickets. :memo:

Jon P.: SG. Also please flag enterprise customers for manual outreach and cc AE team.

Alex R.: Plan: send staged email to affected Dedicated customers at 22:15 UTC (45m before start), post statuspage at 22:30 UTC, and update status every 15m. Maya, Samira — can you finalize and send to #support-ops by 21:45 UTC?

Maya S.: Yep — will post final copy there at 21:40 UTC and queue emails.

Jon P.: Thanks all. Remember to include rollback checklist link in the support playbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/ops/rollback-playbook

Alex R.: Thanks — I'll monitor the rollout with on-call. :rotating_light:
